era: GameCube and modern HD remaster JRPG
summary: Monolith Soft and tri-Crescendo's card-battle JRPG duology, later rereleased as Baten Kaitos I & II HD Remaster.

entries.title: Baten Kaitos: Eternal Wings and the Lost Ocean
entries.definitive_edition: Baten Kaitos I & II HD Remaster

emulation.notes: Use native PC remaster for the main run; use Dolphin only for the original voice presentation.

primary.version: Baten Kaitos I & II HD Remaster
primary.why: The HD Remaster improves graphics and adds progression-help features, and the Windows release is the highest-fidelity capture route. The GameCube original remains relevant only for the removed English voice acting.
primary.how_to_play: Play Baten Kaitos I & II HD Remaster on Steam/Windows. Use Dolphin with a legally dumped GameCube disc only if you specifically want to compare or preserve the original English voice track.

secondary.exclusive_content: Original English voice acting, which is not included in the HD Remaster.
secondary.what_to_play: Use the GameCube version only to sample or preserve the original English voice presentation.
secondary.why: The remaster is the better main route, but the original voice option is a version-specific presentation difference.

all_releases.reason: secondary: lower resolution than the remaster, but retains the original English voice acting.

all_releases.fidelity: HD Remaster console release with improved graphics and progression-help features.
all_releases.reason: skip: strong current route, but Windows has the better capture/fidelity ceiling.
primary: highest-fidelity capture route for the remastered version.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The remaster is higher fidelity and easier to play, but it omits the original English voice acting.

entries.remaster_caveats: The HD Remaster includes Japanese voice acting only; English voice acting from the GameCube original was removed.
